verse.verse_1: OF WHAT ARE they asking one another?
verse.verse_3: About which they have been differing?
verse.verse_4: Indeed they will come to know soon;
verse.verse_5: They will indeed come to know soon.
verse.verse_6: Did We not make the earth a spreading,
verse.verse_9: And made sleep for you to rest,
verse.verse_11: And the day for seeking livelihood.
verse.verse_12: We raised over you several secure (skies),
verse.verse_13: And placed a lamp therein brightly burning.
verse.verse_14: And We sent down rain from water-laden clouds pouring in torrents
verse.verse_15: That We may produce from it grain and vegetation,
verse.verse_16: And orchards full of trees and interlacing boughs.
verse.verse_17: Surely a time is fixed for the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_18: The day the trumpet blast is sounded you will come in hordes;
verse.verse_19: The heavens will be opened wide and turn into so many doors,
verse.verse_20: The mountains put in motion turning into a mirage.
verse.verse_23: Where they will remain for aeons,
verse.verse_24: Finding neither sleep nor any thing to drink
verse.verse_25: Except boiling water and benumbing cold:
verse.verse_27: They were those who did not expect a reckoning,
verse.verse_28: And rejected Our signs as lies.
verse.verse_29: We have kept account of everything in a book.
verse.verse_30: So taste (the fruit of what you sowed), for We shall add nothing but torment,
verse.verse_31: As for those who preserve themselves from evil and follow the straight path, there is attainment for them:
verse.verse_33: And graceful maidens of the same age,
verse.verse_35: They will hear no blasphemies there or disavowals:
verse.verse_36: A recompense from your Lord, a sufficient gift,
verse.verse_37: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that lies between them, most benevolent, to whom none may dare address a word.
verse.verse_38: The day the Spirit takes its stand, with the angels ranged in rows. None will speak except who is permitted by Ar-Rahman and says what is right.
verse.verse_39: That day is certain. So whosoever likes may prepare a way to his Lord.
verse.verse_40: We have indeed warned you of a calamity near at hand, a day when man will see what he had sent (of his deeds) ahead, and the unbeliever will say: "Woe alas. Ah would that I were dust!"
